title: Signs of Fertility
source: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)
content: The 'fertile window' includes the days leading up to and including ovulation. Key physical signs include: 1. Cervical Mucus Changes: Mucus becomes clear, stretchy, and slippery (like raw egg whites) near ovulation to help sperm survive. 2. Basal Body Temperature (BBT): Body temperature slightly dips just before ovulation and rises sharply after ovulation due to progesterone. Tracking these signs helps identify when ovulation occurs.
